tweet.text:
4/ The checking was also cheaper than the vote. With Opus 4.8 it cost $3.92 a task, about half the paper's estimate for voting.
The reason is the cache. The vote reads all ten runs in one big prompt. The checker works in small steps in one session, so 86 to 91% of what it reads the server has already processed, and that part bills at a tenth of the price.
Without that discount, the same checking costs $13.06.
